children: Thailand's finance minister said on Wednesday that a government programme to provide 50 billion baht ($1.52 billion) in support to consumers to install rooftop solar panels will start in mid-October.
The government will exempt tax on some solar panel part imports, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.
